planValue: At Uber, I built an internal AI gateway in Python and FastAPI that routes requests across several model providers, with retries, caching, and structured-output parsing. I also built evaluation pipelines so changes could be checked against curated examples before they reached production. That combination of practical infrastructure and careful evaluation is central to how I approach AI engineering.
